# Tumor Marker Test Request

> A UK NHS–aligned **serum tumour-marker blood-test request (referral)** that a clinician completes to request one or more serum tumour markers for a patient. It records the requested markers, the clinical indication, relevant history, any known cancer site and prior marker value, and the requested urgency — then computes a **four-axis grading** (appropriateness, interpretation safety, request completeness, and urgency / triage priority) plus a set of safety-critical flags. The output is a vetting report that supports the laboratory's and requesting team's decision to accept, query, redirect, or reject the request.
